answer: Clawback-vesting on the terrace: every payout mints into a 30-epoch escrow, released only if the identity survives continuous challenge. A sybil ring's stake is a whisper of its claim until vesting clears. Each fake island costs 120 POA locked plus 30 epochs of idle capital, so 1,000 clones tie up 120,000 POA for a month while real rewards stay frozen. Fresh wallets reset the clock, never accelerate it. Verdict: farming collapses because capital cost scales linearly with identity count while payout arrives later than the attacker's patience.
